verdict.rationale: Make documents a first-party AI Agents app for agentic automation, with API endpoints to create and run AI agents (open beta). This suggests in-product agents that can take on tasks. The MCP server and Make Skills serve external assistants like Claude and ChatGPT, so they earn no credit for a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: clear evidence of an in-product conversational assistant users delegate tasks to, detail on what the AI agents can do, non-beta status, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: learn about agentic automation with the make ai agents app
The following endpoints allow you to get, create, update, delete, and run AI Agents. These endpoints are available in **open beta** to all users.
